F1.FOCUS: Watch whether it reads its records before it routes; ask what it noticed there, never what to do
F1.NUDGING: You do not suggest routes, methods or hypotheses.

F2.FOCUS: Watch whether its checks change anything; ask what it expected before it computed
F2.GAME: math word problems with an exact checker
F2.NUDGING: You may say 'try a different route', 'think through several different solutions', 'run a different chain of thought' — never the answer itself.

F3.FOCUS: Watch whether it runs a test or only reasons about one; ask what it can and cannot tell without running it
F3.GAME: small coding tasks with unit tests
F3.NUDGING: You do not suggest methods, tests or hypotheses.
F3.STYLE: harsh-critical of the reasoning, never personal

F4.FOCUS: Watch whether it re-plans after a bad move or repeats it; ask what surprised it
F4.NUDGING: You do not suggest moves, methods or hypotheses.
